ayahOccurrences.text: وَٱلْوَٰلِدَٰتُ يُرْضِعْنَ أَوْلَٰدَهُنَّ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ ۖ لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يُتِمَّ ٱلرَّضَاعَةَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱلْمَوْلُودِ لَهُۥ رِزْقُهُنَّ وَكِسْوَتُهُنَّ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۚ لَا تُكَلَّفُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَا تُضَآرَّ وَٰلِدَةٌۢ بِوَلَدِهَا وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ لَّهُۥ بِوَلَدِهِۦ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱلْوَارِثِ مِثْلُ ذَٰلِكَ ۗ فَإِنْ أَرَادَا فِصَالًا عَن تَرَاضٍ مِّنْهُمَا وَتَشَاوُرٍ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا ۗ وَإِنْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن تَسْتَرْضِعُوٓا۟ أَوْلَٰدَكُمْ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذَا سَلَّمْتُم مَّآ آتَيْتُمْ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

entries.label: أَبْصَرَ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَبْصَرَ ʾabṣara [v. IV trans.]

1 to see

(7:179) وَلَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌ لاَ يُبْصِرُونَ بِهَا they have eyes they do not see with

2 to comprehend, to understand

(28:72) مَنْ إِلَهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُمْ بِلَيْلٍ تَسْكُنُونَ فِيهِ أَفَلاَ تُبْصِرُونَ what god other than He could give you night in which to rest?, do you not comprehend?

3 to find guidance

(6:104) قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ بَصَائِرُ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَمَنْ أَبْصَرَ فَلِنَفْسِهِ clear proofs have come to you from your Lord–so whoever finds guidance, it is for himself.

entries.label: أَبْصِرْ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَبْصِرْ بِـ ʾabṣir bi [exclamation] how strong the eyesight is!

(18:26) قُلِ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثُوا لَهُ غَيْبُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ أَبْصِرْ بِهِ وَأَسْمِعْ say, ‘God knows best how long they remained,’ His is all that is hidden in the heavens and the earth–how well He sees!, how well He hears!

entries.label: بَصُرَ
entries.definitionHtml:
بَصُرَ baṣura u [v. intrans. with prep. بـ]

1 to see, comprehend, to gain knowledge of something,

(20:96) قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوا بِهِ he said, ‘I saw what they did not see’ [in another interpretation: ‘I have gained insight into something which they were unable to see’]

2 to keep an eye on, to watch over

(28:11) وَقَالَتْ لأُِخْتِهِ قُصِّيهِ فَبَصُرَتْ بِهِ عَنْ جُنُبٍ وَهُمْ لاَ يَشْعُرُونَ and she said to his sister, ‘Track him,’ so she watched him from a distance, while they were unaware.

entries.label: بَصِيرٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
بَصِيرٌ baṣır [intens. act. part./quasi‐act. part.]

1 one who can see, one endowed with sight

(12:96) فَلَمَّا أَنْ جَاءَ الْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَاهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فَارْتَدَّ بَصِيرًا then, when the bearer of good news came and placed it onto his face–thereupon he became able to see again

2 one discerning, endowed with insight *

(42:11) الْبَصِيرُ [attribute of God] the All‐Seeing, the All‐Discerning.

entries.label: بَصِيرَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
بَصِيرَةٌ baṣıratun I [v. n./n., pl. بَصَائِر baṣāʾir] clear evidence, sure knowledge

(12:108) أَدْعُو إِلَى اللَّهِ عَلَى بَصِيرَةٍ I call to God with sure knowledge II [n.] witness, overseer

(75:14) بَلِ الإِنْسَانُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ truly, man is a [clear] witness against himself [in another interpretation: there is an observer observing him].

entries.label: تَبْصِرَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
تَبْصِرَةٌ tabṣiratun [v. n.] providing insight, showing the way, eyesight

(50:8) تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَى لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُنِيبٍ as an eye‐opener and a reminder for every servant who turns to God.

entries.label: مُبْصِرٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مُبْصِرٌ mubṣir [act. part.; pl. مُبْصِرُون mubṣirūn; fem. مُبْصِرَةٌ mubṣiratun]

1 one who sees; one who has insight, one who discerns

(7:201) إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا إِذَا مَسَّهُمْ طَائِفٌ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ تَذَكَّرُوا فَإِذَا هُمْ مُبْصِرُونَ those who are mindful of God, if a visitation [of thoughts] from Satan touched them, they remember [Him] and, lo and behold, they have insight

2 light/sight‐giving

(10:67) هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا فِيهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا He it is who made the night for you to rest in [it] and the day giving light/sight

3 clear, evident, plain to see

(27:13) فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْهُمْ ءَايَاتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً but when Our clear signs came to them.

entries.label: مُسْتَبْصِرِين
entries.definitionHtml:
مُسْتَبْصِرِين mustabṣirın [pl. of act. part. مُسْتَبْصِرٌ mustabṣir] one who seeks insights, capable of having insight into matters

(29:38) وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمَ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ Satan made their foul deeds seem alluring to them and barred them from the right way, [even] though they were capable of seeing.

entries.label: يُبَصَّرُ
entries.definitionHtml:
يُبَصَّرُ yubaṣṣar [imperf. of pass. v. II بُصِّرَ buṣṣira] to be made to see/comprehend something, to be given an insight into

(70:11) يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ they are enabled to see them (or, they are given an insight into them).
